## Summary

```text
Cartesian product
  error → report proven occurrence positions before typed selection
  drop  → compare cube memberships after accounting for covered columns
```

Closes #1266.
Closes #1274.

## Evidence

- **Before** — DuckDB requested typed metadata and called the predicate before reporting positions 1 and 2. With 18 keys and a 96 MiB R vector heap, inspection and both nesting verbs reached the heap limit in both factor orders.
- **After** — The DuckDB and dtplyr regressions exercise the early duplicate diagnostic and deferred typed selection. The heap fixture passes across all three APIs in both factor orders for direct and union-wrapped cubes. An independent enumeration agrees for 900 small products. The two bounded nested-product controls reach their typed predicate.
- [Full Review-ready and focused evidence for `ec8f57f6`](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1286#issuecomment-6634490398)
- [Standards and Spec review with follow-up dispositions](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1286#issuecomment-6634491246)

## Merge Danger

**Door** — Two-way. The change is confined to Grouping plan compilation and its tests.

**Blast Radius** — Inspection and Margin verbs that compile Cartesian products with duplicate handling.
title: Handle duplicate grouping sets during Cartesian product expansion

## Summary

```text
Grouping specification
├─ resolve numbered dots, empty arguments and ambiguous names
├─ resolve typed selections and reject completed duplicate prefixes
├─ retain first occurrences during duplicate-drop cube and product expansion
└─ document identity aliases
```

Closes #1227
Closes #1234
Closes #1240
Closes #1233
Closes #1228
Closes #1245
Closes #1244

## Evidence

- **Before** A parenthesized or injected `..01` selection could error, a typed selector after an established duplicate could trigger a DuckDB send, and repeated cube or product expansion could exhaust a capped heap.
- **After** Both issue-comment Expand reproductions pass. The selection replay matches tidyselect across 144 cases, early duplicate refusal sends zero DuckDB queries, and the repeated-family and mandatory-factor Inspect and Expand probes pass at 64 MiB.
- [Verification and acceptance results](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1250#issuecomment-6625102792)
- [Standards and Spec review](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1250#issuecomment-6625103284)

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

The package changes can be reverted through Git.

**Blast Radius:** grouping

Grouping specification constructors, inspection, and Margin verbs share the changed resolution and planning paths.
title: Preserve Grouping argument resolution and compact duplicate-drop plans
